title: Senior FPGA Developer
description:
About the Company : Working for a global provider of network test, monitoring and assurance solutions for telecommunications, cloud, enterprises, first responders, military, aerospace, and railway. A leader in light management technologies for 3D sensing, anti-counterfeiting, consumer electronics, industrial, automotive, government and aerospace applications. Employees working on this project are passionate about supporting customer success and we welcome people who bring their best every day to the company – to question, to collaborate and to push for solutions that will delight our customers.



About the Role : We are seeking a Principal/Staff-level FPGA Engineer — a recognized technical authority — to own FPGA architecture for our state-of-the-art Communications Test & Measurement products.



Responsibilities :



  • The successful candidate will define and drive end-to-end FPGA architecture, including make/buy tradeoffs on IP, floorplanning and timing closure strategy for multi-gigabit designs, and DFX approach, using Verilog/SystemVerilog/VHDL and industry-leading simulation, synthesis, place-and-route, and formal/UVM verification tools.
  • This person will serve as the final technical escalation point for FPGA design and debug issues across the team, mentor other FPGA engineers, and lead root-cause debug of silicon and board bring-up issues that could not be resolved elsewhere.


Qualifications :



  • BS or MS degree in Electrical and/or Computer Engineering with a minimum of 12-15 years of relevant experience, including at least 5+ years specifically architecting and closing timing on multi-Gbps SerDes/transceiver-based FPGA designs.


Required Skills :



  • Demonstrated expertise architecting and implementing high-speed FPGA designs using Verilog/SystemVerilog and/or VHDL required.
  • Deep, hands-on expertise with FPGA transceivers, hard IP, and PLLs — including timing closure, equalization, and link debug at multi-Gbps rates — required (not incidental exposure).
  • Demonstrated experience closing timing and debugging link-layer issues on high-speed Ethernet (10M to 1.6T) and IP protocol stacks in production designs.
  • Proven expertise with optical interfaces and modules (SFPs, QSFPs) in shipped products.
  • Deep working knowledge of VLANs, MPLS, VPLS, and Voice/Video over IP (VoIP, IPTV).
  • Extensive experience with AMD or Altera FPGA devices and their full implementation toolchains, including advanced timing closure and floorplanning techniques.
  • Proven experience with formal verification and/or UVM-based verification methodologies, not limited to directed testbenches.
  • Demonstrated track record of taking FPGA designs from architecture through volume production, including systems-level tradeoffs across the HW/FW boundary.
  • Version control experience using Git or similar tools.
  • Exceptional written and oral communication skills, including the ability to mentor engineers and communicate architecture decisions with stakeholders across the world.
  • Exceptional analytical and organizational skills, with an uncompromising commitment to accuracy and technical rigor in a fast-paced product environment.


Preferred Skills : Languages: English: B2 Upper Intermediate

title: Professor de inglês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?


  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Executive Producer
description:
Buscamos um(a) profissional com sólida experiência em produção audiovisual, incluindo produções de foto e vídeo (live action) e pós-produção, abrangendo edição de vídeo, animação 2D/3D e produção de áudio. Experiência com experiências interativas, instalações, realidade virtual e aumentada, bem como produção para eventos e experiências (experiential), será considerada um diferencial. Inglês fluente é mandatório para esta vaga uma vez que trabalhamos em parceria com times internacionais.

Principais Responsabilidades

Liderança e Gestão da Produção

  • Liderar a equipe de Produção e Business Affairs da Studio Rx Brasil.
  • Gerenciar, desenvolver e orientar a equipe de Produtores(as), distribuindo projetos em parceria com a liderança de alocação de recursos (Resourcing), garantindo comunicação clara e entregas dentro dos prazos.
  • Avaliar os projetos recebidos e designar o(a) produtor(a) mais adequado(a), considerando disponibilidade, competências e experiência com a marca.
  • Planejar e ajustar a estrutura da equipe de acordo com a demanda de trabalho.
  • Fornecer feedback contínuo e conduzir avaliações anuais de desempenho.
  • Participar dos processos de recrutamento, seleção e contratação de novos profissionais.

Gestão Financeira de Projetos

  • Em parceria com as áreas de Finanças e Operações, estabelecer e manter processos claros para estimativas de custos e elaboração de propostas comerciais.
  • Compreender as tabelas de preços (rate cards) e os modelos de faturamento de cada cliente.
  • Definir e atualizar benchmarks de projetos.
  • Revisar todas as estimativas e propostas antes de sua aprovação e envio.
  • Liderar a gestão de alterações de escopo, custos adicionais (overages) e demais impactos financeiros dos projetos.
  • Colaborar com as equipes de Atendimento da Studio Rx no planejamento anual de escopo de trabalho (Scope of Work).

Crescimento e Estratégia

  • Pesquisar e compartilhar fornecedores de produção de referência, além das principais tendências e inovações do mercado.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com a Diretoria Executiva para expandir as capacidades da Studio Rx e identificar oportunidades de parceria dentro da indústria.
  • Supervisionar todos os projetos, assegurando rentabilidade e identificando oportunidades de ganho de eficiência.
  • Em parceria com a liderança do estúdio, gerenciar ferramentas e processos de Project Management.
  • Desenvolver estratégias de planejamento e alocação de recursos para maximizar a utilização das capacidades do estúdio.

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Mínimo de 10 anos de experiência em produção, com forte atuação em pós-produção, preferencialmente em agências de publicidade ou produtoras.
  • Experiência em produção digital será considerada um diferencial.
  • Excelente capacidade de organização, planejamento e resolução de problemas.
  • Atenção excepcional aos detalhes.
  • Perfil flexível, orientado a processos e capaz de lidar com múltiplas demandas e diferentes fontes de informação simultaneamente.
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, com habilidade para apresentar ideias de forma clara e objetiva.
  • Perfil proativo, colaborativo, ágil e orientado para soluções.
  • Capacidade de manter a calma, tomar decisões e liderar equipes em ambientes dinâmicos e de alta pressão.

description:

Candidates that don't fill out our form will not be considered -->

------


At Digital Ride, we’re looking for a talented and versatile video editor to join our team. You’ll be in charge of producing killer ads weekly for our multi million dollar brands,


The ideal candidate will identify opportunities for creative improvement to both our paid and organic content across Facebook, YouTube, Instagram, etc. and solve the identified problems with your creative skillset to assist in driving revenue and sales. You’ll work across a wide variety of digital consumer-facing projects, support our marketing team, and assist in creative efforts on the websites, social media, and other campaigns.


All candidates must understand social media deeply and be well versed in ecommerce video advertising.


Responsibilities include:


  • Delivering performance Ecom videos weekly
  • Learning and iterating from paid ad metrics
  • Participating in creative brainstorming sessions
  • Identifying new content and creative opportunities for all channels
  • Managing inbound content


What you bring to the party:


  • 2+ years of experience with Premiere or similar video editing software
  • 1+ years of experience with social and ecommerce ad creation
  • Must be an avid Tik Tok and Social Media user
  • Great english comms
  • Ability to take creative feedback and incorporate it quickly
  • Ability to work in a collaborative team environment
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Graphic design experience a big bonus
  • Speed


Benefits:


  • Fully remote position, work from anywhere
  • Competitive salary + incentives
  • Extensive in house training. You'll become a top 1% Ecommerce video editor and learn from top 1% media buyers.
  • Work with a multicultural team on several multi million dollar Ecommerce brands


If this sounds like you, please fill out the form linked below. If we like what we see, we'll be in touch soon!

title: Clinical & Marketing Specialist
description:
Our client is a leading balloon catheter research, development, production, and sales enterprise, possessing globally leading balloon catheter technology and manufacturing capabilities. Since its establishment over a decade ago, the company has grown to a large scale, with R&D centers, operational centers, and production bases established worldwide.

Responsibilities

  • Provide on-site clinical support during interventional procedures, including PTCA, PTA, and interventional accessories, with a strong focus on coronary specialty balloons such as specialty scoring and CTO balloon products.
  • Support distributors and physicians during case coverage, product demonstrations, and technical guidance in catheterization laboratories.
  • Manage and develop key hospitals and key opinion leaders (KOLs) within assigned regions, ensuring continuous clinical follow-up and strong professional relationships.
  • Work closely with the sales team and distributors to support regional sales objectives; proactively assist in product positioning, clinical adoption, and procedure planning.
  • Participate in and support major medical congresses, workshops, live cases, and training programs, including booth support and academic promotion.
  • Deliver clinical training and product education to distributors, sales representatives, and healthcare professionals.
  • Collect and provide market intelligence, competitive insights, and clinical feedback from the field to support marketing and product strategy.
  • Assist in the launch of new products and support post-market clinical follow-up.
  • Ensure all activities comply with local regulations, company policies, and compliance standards.


Qualifications

Language proficiency:

  • High-level command of a local language
  • Ability to communicate in English for basic work-related communications (for collaboration with headquarters)

Industry background:

  • Relevant experience in healthcare sectors such as medical practitioners, nurses, pharmaceutical representatives, medical device/pharmaceutical distributors
  • Preference given to candidates familiar with local healthcare systems, distribution channels, and client needs

Core qualities:

  • Passionate about sales work, goal-oriented, results-driven
  • Strong self-motivation and adaptability to remote work modes
  • Excellent communication skills and customer service awareness

title: Head of Risk, Brazil
description:
Role Objective: We are seeking an experienced and highly strategic Statutory Risk Officer to

lead our Risk Management function in Brazil. This executive role is pivotal in acting as the

primary interface with local regulatory bodies, specifically the Central Bank of Brazil (BACEN).

The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in Operational and Technology Risk, ensuring

our fast-paced operations remain resilient, secure, and fully compliant.


About the Role

As the Statutory Risk Officer, you will hold statutory responsibility for the company's risk

management framework in Brazil. You will act as the designated point of contact for BACEN and

other relevant regulatory bodies, advocating for the business while ensuring strict adherence to local regulatory expectations. While the role requires holistic oversight of the enterprise risk landscape, the primary mandate is to architect, implement, and govern a robust Operational Risk and Technology Risk framework. You will partner with business and technology leaders to identify vulnerabilities, mitigate technological threats, and foster a culture of proactive risk management.


Key Responsibilities

Regulatory Leadership & Statutory Duties

  • Act as the formally appointed Statutory Risk Director before the Central Bank of Brazil (BACEN),fulfilling all duties required by BACEN Resolution and related regulations.
  • Serve as the primary liaison for all regulatory inquiries, audits, and supervisory exams related to risk management.
  • Ensure accurate and timely submission of all mandated risk reports to regulators.
  • Monitor regulatory developments and proactively adapt the risk framework to meet emerging legislative and supervisory requirements.


Operational cum Technology Risk Management

  • Oversee the end-to-end Operational Risk Management (ORM) framework, including Risk Control Self-Assessments (RCSA), Key Risk Indicators (KRIs), and Incident Management.
  • Establish and monitor operational risk appetite metrics and thresholds, escalating breaches to the management
  • Drive business continuity planning (BCP) and disaster recovery (DR) strategies to ensure operational resilience.
  • Provide in-depth oversight of Technology Risk, Information Security, and Cyber Security
  • frameworks.
  • Evaluate risks associated with digital transformations, cloud migrations, API integrations, and new technology deployments.
  • Oversee Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM), focusing heavily on critical IT vendors and outsourced technology service providers.
  • Review and challenge incident response protocols and post-mortem analysis for IT disruptions or cyber incidents.


Financial Risk (Advantageous Focus)

Good knowledge over end-to-end financial, fraud risk management during payment and money conversion and transfer process, for dual B2C (high-volume, rapid retail transactions) and B2B (high-value invoice/account-to-account payouts) flows.


Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Law, Economics, Business Administration, Finance, or related field.
  • Strong experience in risk management and/or internal controls within regulated financial institutions in Brazil (banks, payment institutions, brokerages, or asset managers).
  • Solid working knowledge of BCB regulatory processes, norms, and resolutions.
  • Prior experience engaging directly with BCB and/or CVM in a regulatory/supervisory context.
  • Strong understanding of prudential risk frameworks (capital, RWA, operational risk).
  • Brazilian national or foreign national with valid Brazilian residency (statutory officer requirement).
  • Availability and willingness to be formally listed as a company officer with associated legal responsibilities.
  • Fluent Portuguese and Advanced English.
  • Prior experience in virtual assets, crypto, or fintech risk management.
  • Domain Expertise: SME-level knowledge in Operational Risk and Technology/Cyber Risk methodologies.
  • Professional certifications in risk management (e.g., FRM, CRM) a plus.
  • Familiarity with VASP-specific prudential frameworks and evolving BCB guidance on RWA treatment for digital asset activities.


P/S: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted due to overwhelming applicants.


Vision & Mission

OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain's \"killer app,\" with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.


OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Designer de embalagens
description:
Vaga: Designer de Embalagens (PJ) – Remoto


Estamos em busca de um profissional criativo, criterioso e tecnicamente sólido para integrar nossa equipe de forma remota.

É indispensável possuir experiência em desenvolvimento de embalagens , além de domínio em branding e direção de arte, sendo capaz de conduzir projetos desde o conceito até a entrega final.



Principais responsabilidades
  • Desenvolvimento de identidades visuais e sistemas de marca;
  • Criação de logotipos e projetos de branding;
  • Desenvolvimento de embalagens para diferentes segmentos (requisito essencial);
  • Criação de materiais institucionais e publicitários;
  • Fechamento de arquivos para impressão;
  • Garantir a qualidade estética e técnica das entregas.


Requisitos
  • Experiência comprovada como Designer Gráfico ou Diretor de Arte;
  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento de embalagens;
  • Experiência em branding e desenvolvimento de identidades visuais;
  • Domínio avançado do Adobe Illustrator;
  • Domínio avançado do Adobe Photoshop;
  • Conhecimento em processos gráficos e preparação de arquivos para impressão;
  • Experiência com processos de impressão aplicados a embalagens (flexografia, offset, rotogravura e impressão digital);
  • Conhecimento em fechamento e preparação de arquivos para produção gráfica;
  • Experiência com facas, gabaritos e especificações técnicas de embalagens;
  • Conhecimento em materiais, substratos e acabamentos gráficos aplicados a embalagens;
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de linhas de produtos e desdobramentos de embalagem;
  • Vivência em projetos de embalagens para segmentos como alimentício, bebidas, cosméticos, farmacêutico ou varejo.



Perfil esperado
  • Excelente senso estético;
  • Facilidade para trabalhar em equipe;
  • Comprometimento com prazos e qualidade;
  • Interesse em aprendizado contínuo.



Modalidade
  • Pessoa Jurídica (PJ);
  • 100% remoto;



Como se candidatar

Envie para:

✔ Currículo atualizado;

✔ Portfólio;

✔ Trabalhos realizados (cases ou projetos profissionais, principalmente de embalagens);

✔ Pretensão de remuneração para atuação na modalidade PJ.




⚠️ Importante: É obrigatório enviar currículo, portfólio e exemplos de trabalhos já realizados, especialmente projetos de desenvolvimento de embalagens e branding. Candidaturas sem portfólio ou sem materiais que comprovem experiência na área não serão consideradas.

title: Remote Dental RCM Billing Specialist – U.S. Dental Experience
description:
Remote Dental RCM Billing Specialist – U.S. Dental Experience

Location: Remote – Brazil or Colombia

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM Central Time (U.S.)

Job Type: Independent Contractor

Language: Fluent professional English required

We are seeking an experienced Dental RCM Billing Specialist located in Brazil or Colombia to join our growing remote team. This position supports dental practices in the United States and requires prior experience with U.S. dental insurance, billing, claims, or accounts receivable.

Applicants from Brazil and Colombia are strongly encouraged to apply. This is a fully remote, long-term opportunity with training, support, and room for professional growth.

Responsibilities:

• Submit and follow up on dental insurance claims

• Work insurance aging reports and follow up on unpaid or denied claims

• Correct claim rejections and submit appeals

• Review EOBs and insurance payment information

• Post insurance payments and adjustments accurately

• Verify patient eligibility and dental benefits when needed

• Contact U.S. insurance companies by telephone and through payer portals

• Maintain detailed account notes and follow-up dates

• Communicate professionally with management and dental office team members

• Protect patient information and follow HIPAA and confidentiality requirements

Qualifications:

• At least one year of U.S. dental billing, insurance, collections, or verification experience

• Strong spoken and written English

• Knowledge of dental terminology, CDT codes, EOBs, deductibles, maximums, downgrades, frequencies, and PPO insurance

• Experience with dental practice-management software

• Experience with Open Dental, Dentrix, Dentrix Ascend, Curve, CareStack, Denticon, Eaglesoft, or WinOMS is a plus

• Oral surgery or medical billing experience is a plus

• Reliable computer, high-speed internet, backup internet, and a quiet private workspace

• Ability to work independently, meet deadlines, and maintain accurate documentation

• Availability during U.S. Central Time business hours

What We Offer:

• Permanent work-from-home arrangement

• Long-term opportunity

• Training and ongoing support

• Opportunity to grow within an international dental RCM team

• Collaborative and professional working environment

To Apply:

Please submit your résumé in English and include:

  • Your country and city
  • Years of U.S. dental billing or insurance experience
  • Dental software you have used
  • Your level of spoken English
  • Your available working hours in Central Time
  • Your internet speed and whether you have backup internet
  • Your compensation expectations

title: ANALISTA DE FINOPS PL, REMOTO.
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições:


Visibilidade e Alocação de Custos:

  • Implementar e manter a estratégia de tagging e alocação de custos (AWS Cost Allocation Tags)
  • Criar e gerenciar dashboards no AWS Cost Explorer, CUR (Cost and Usage Report) e ferramentas de BI
  • Produzir relatórios periódicos de custos por unidade de negócio, equipe e produto


Otimização e Eficiência:

  • Identificar oportunidades de rightsizing, uso de Savings Plans, Reserved Instances e Spot Instances
  • Analisar e recomendar ações com base no AWS Trusted Advisor e AWS Compute Optimizer
  • Monitorar e reduzir recursos ociosos ou subutilizados (EBS não anexados, IPs elásticos, snapshots antigos)


Governança e Orçamento:

  • Configurar e gerenciar Budgets com alertas e ações automatizadas
  • Definir e acompanhar KPIs de custo (custo por transação, custo por cliente, unit economics).
  • Apoiar na elaboração de políticas de governança via AWS Organizations e SCPs


Cultura FinOps:

  • Promover a prática de showback/chargeback entre as equipes
  • Preparar o material de reuniões recorrentes de revisão de custos com stakeholders técnicos e de negócio.
  • Evangelizar as fases do framework FinOps: Inform → Optimize → Operate


Forecasting e Planejamento:

  • Elaborar previsões de gastos (forecasting) e apoiar o ciclo de planejamento orçamentário.
  • Analisar tendências de consumo e anomalias de custo (AWS Cost Anomaly Detection).


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • 2 a 4 anos de experiência com gestão de custos em nuvem (AWS, Azure, GCP ou OCI).
  • Conhecimento sólido dos serviços AWS de billing: Cost Explorer, CUR, Budgets, Cost Anomaly Detection
  • Familiaridade com o framework FinOps Foundation (fases, personas, princípios)
  • Experiência com ferramentas de visualização de dados (QuickSight, Grafana, Tableau ou similares).
  • Capacidade analítica para trabalhar com grandes volumes de dados de billing (SQL, Python ou similar).
  • Boa comunicação para traduzir dados técnicos em insights de negócio.


Informações adicionais:

O que você pode esperar da gente?

  • Participação nos lucros: resultados com comemoração fazem parte do jeito Cogna.
  • Vale-refeição ou alimentação: num cartão de benefícios flexível.
  • Assistência médica: um abrangente plano de saúde, com inclusão de dependentes e coparticipação.
  • Assistência odontológica: está disponível para manter seu sorriso.

title: Senior Application Scientist and Business Partnerships Executive
description:
Location

Brazil (remote)


Summary of the role

As a Senior Application Scientist, you will play a crucial role in bridging scientific knowledge with practical application. In this full-time position, you’ll be at the forefront of driving the development of our tools, through understanding and addressing our members’ needs. By fostering strong relationships with our members and internal teams, you’ll support Lhasa in developing cutting-edge software solutions, which solve real-world chemical safety assessment problems, whilst generating new leads across core industry sectors. In this role you are accountable for increasing revenue through the sponsorship of our in-silico solutions across our core industry sectors.


Main Responsibilities:

Include but are not limited to:

  • Engage with members to ensure retention by understanding regional scientific and regulatory challenges.
  • Develops market research and business intelligence strategies for relevant sectors to increase revenue through the sponsorship of our in-silico solutions.
  • Promote Lhasa’s solutions to drive adoption and revenue growth by upselling solutions to current members.
  • Identify and develop business relationships with prospects from various industries.
  • Respond to enquiries and deliver tailored demonstrations of Lhasa’s software solutions.
  • Translate complex scientific developments into practical applications for members and prospects.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with members, prospects, and regulators.
  • Deliver training sessions and provide ongoing scientific support to members.
  • Represent and support Lhasa at scientific events, conferences, webinars, and exhibitions.
  • Contribute to external communications, including LinkedIn posts, videos, and other promotional content.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to align regional activities with global strategy.


Attributes:

  • Strong scientific background in chemistry, toxicology, degradation, or metabolism, or an undergraduate degree, masters, or PhD in a relevant scientific field.
  • Proof of at least 3 years of experience in relevant industry (e.g. cosmetics, pharmaceutical, food, agrochemicals)
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly.
  • Understanding of chemical structures and the application of in silico predictions
  • Knowledge of toxicology, metabolism, degradation, and organic reaction mechanisms
  • Experience in customer-facing roles, ideally in a scientific or technical environment.
  • Self-motivated and able to work independently as well as collaboratively
  • Willingness to travel frequently within the region
  • Able to work as part of a multidisciplinary team and independently
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English, Spanish is desirable
  • Alignment with Lhasa’s values and mission

title: Designer
description:
Position: Designer

Location: Remote (Mexico / Colombia / Brazil / Costa Rica)

Duration: 3-6 month contract with extensions

Pay Rate: 78 to 104 BRL


Qualifications:

Required Skills & Experience:

  • 5+ years of professional animation experience.
  • 5+ years experience within Figma / with teams within Figma.
  • Expert-level animation portfolio demonstrating work for reputable brands or agencies.
  • Advanced experience with Adobe After Effects.
  • Advanced experience with Adobe Premiere Pro.
  • Strong digital and social media animation background.
  • Ability to create storyboards and develop concepts from the ground up.
  • Strong design sensibility and visual storytelling skills.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.
  • Ability to absorb creative direction and transform concepts into engaging animations quickly.


Nice to Have Skills & Experience:

  • Agency experience.
  • Experience supporting paid media campaigns.
  • Experience creating Instagram-focused animated content.
  • Experience supporting major consumer brands.
  • Portfolio featuring work for recognized global brands such as Nike, Apple, or similar organizations.
  • Experience working in high-volume, fast-paced creative environments.


Job Description:

Our client is seeking a Digital Animator / Designer to support a fast-paced internal creative studio responsible for developing digital content across social media, web, CRM, retail, and marketing campaigns. This individual will serve as an extension of the core design team, bringing highly creative animation capabilities while contributing to select front-end design initiatives. Approximately 85% of the role will focus on animation.


Responsibilities:

  • Create and animate content for social media, web, CRM, retail marketing, and campaign assets.
  • Develop animations for Instagram reels, stories, highlights, and paid media initiatives.
  • Edit and recut video content for digital campaigns, retail video walls, temporary retail environments, and promotional assets.
  • Collaborate closely with designers and marketing stakeholders to execute creative briefs. Participate in storyboard development, concept ideation, and art boarding before production begins.
  • Bring new creative ideas and proactively contribute to campaign development.
  • Support high-volume creative production with quick turnaround requirements.
  • Attend regular stand-ups and work alongside the studio's design and animation teams.
  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining quality and speed.
  • Help commercialize creative materials supporting IQOS and ZYN initiatives.

title: Auxiliar de Loja - Shopping Campo Grande (Vaga Afirmativa para Pessoas com Deficiência/PCD´s)
description:
Descrição da vaga


Na L’Occitane, acreditamos que a diversidade fortalece nossos times e que diferentes experiências, histórias e perspectivas fazem parte da nossa essência.

Estamos em busca de profissionais para atuar como Auxiliar de Loja, contribuindo para a organização da operação e para a melhor experiência dos nossos clientes. Se você tem vontade de aprender, se desenvolver e crescer profissionalmente, queremos conhecer você.


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Apoiar as atividades relacionadas ao caixa, como organização do espaço, embalagem de produtos, conferência e suporte ao atendimento;
  • Apoiar a equipe no atendimento aos clientes, especialmente em momentos de maior fluxo;
  • Realizar a organização, reposição e abastecimento dos produtos da loja;
  • Auxiliar na organização do estoque e no recebimento, conferência e organização de produtos e materiais;
  • Apoiar nas demais atividades da rotina da loja, contribuindo para o bom funcionamento da operação e trabalhando em parceria com o time;
  • Participar dos treinamentos e ações de desenvolvimento oferecidos pela empresa.



Requisitos e qualificações

Valorizamos pessoas com vontade de aprender, se desenvolver e contribuir para um ambiente colaborativo.

Experiência anterior em varejo não é obrigatória. Se você está buscando sua primeira oportunidade ou deseja iniciar uma nova trajetória profissional, queremos conhecer você.

Informações adicionais

Escala 5x2: Folgas alternadas, com disponibilidade para trabalhar também aos sábados e domingos , conforme a escala.

🦩 VR + VA: Vale Refeição e Alimentação de R$ 775,00 , disponibilizados em cartão flexível.

🚌 VT: Vale Transporte.

Assistência Médica: Parcerias para cuidar da sua saúde.

🦷 Assistência Odontológica: Cuidado com o seu sorriso e o da sua família.

Licença Parentalidade: Licença estendida de 6 meses para o primeiro cuidador e 3 meses para o segundo cuidador .

Programa Sou’L: Programa de saúde psicológica e bem-estar para você e seus dependentes.

♀️ TotalPass: Acesso a uma ampla rede de academias e parceiros focados em saúde e bem-estar.

🛡️ Seguro de Vida: Cuidado e segurança para quem faz parte do nosso time.

Voucher de Aniversário: Presente para produtos nas lojas ou uma experiência no SPA.

🧡 Desconto L’Occitane: 40% de desconto em produtos nas nossas lojas próprias e 50% de desconto em pacotes de SPA.

title: OCM (Organisational Change Management) Lead
description:
Organisational Change Management Lead - Contract - Remote


Working Model: Remote

Duration: 12 months

Start Date: ASAP

Language: Portuguese speaking


We are looking for an experienced OCM Lead to lead Organisational Change Management activities across the ACC region, with the primary focus on Brazil .

The OCM Lead will be accountable for the timely and high-quality execution of the OCM methodology and deliverables , ensuring activities remain aligned to the overall programme roadmap. The role will work closely with country teams, the Americas Regional OCM team and the Global OCM team.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead OCM delivery across the ACC region, with a strong focus on Brazil.
  • Ensure the timely and quality execution of OCM methodology and deliverables .
  • Develop and maintain the OCM plan , aligned with programme timelines and key milestones.
  • Provide weekly status updates on OCM deliverables and progress against the roadmap..
  • Support individual countries in identifying and mitigating local change risks .
  • Work closely with the Regional OCM team and Global OCM team to ensure alignment and consistency.


Experience & Skills

  • Experience in change management, organisational change and/or business transformation.
  • Proven experience leading OCM activities within an ERP implementation or transformation programme .
  • Strong experience developing and managing OCM plans, deliverables and risks.
  • Experience working within regional and global transformation programmes .
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and manage priorities in a fast-paced programme environment.

title: GTM Education & Community Manager
description:
We're hiring someone who walks into a room of founders and owns it by minute two.


R$14,700 to R$20,600 Monthly | Brazil, remote (Rio de Janeiro preferred) | Unlimited PTO


The role

You inherit a training program and a community that already work, and you are handed full ownership of both. From there it is yours: what gets taught and to whom, how the community runs, where the whole thing goes next. You teach live every week to founders betting their company on Microsoft Marketplace, and you own the number that says it landed. A real program to run and grow, not a blank page and not somebody else's to approve.


You'll join a marketing team of four (designer, growth marketer, content marketer), report to the Head of Marketing, and work daily with Customer Success, Account Managers, and Partnerships.


Who we're looking for

Someone who loves to teach and misses it when they stop. You can hold a room of CEOs, marketing and sales directors in English, and take a hard question without losing the thread. You come from B2B sales, marketing, or startups, so the room recognizes you as one of them.


What you'll own


1. The program

  • The curriculum plan: what gets taught, in what order, to whom
  • Live delivery, on camera, weekly
  • Learning design: objectives, exercises, assessment, not slides
  • The metric that proves it worked, and the rewrite when it didn't

2. The community

  • Programming calendar, member journey, moderation standard
  • Engaged participation as the number, not signups
  • Members turned into content contributors
  • Recurring interviews with our CEO, partners, and customers


What you bring

  • 3-5 years teaching or running education programs. B2B SaaS strongly preferred
  • End-to-end ownership of a training program, not delivery only
  • Live teaching to a business audience
  • Community building: a peer network, user group, or alumni cohort
  • Hands-on with GTM tooling, enough to teach while using it
  • AI in your daily workflow, with the judgment to review it. Raw AI output doesn't ship here


Nice to have

  • Microsoft partner, cloud marketplace, or co-sell motion
  • GTM tools: Clay, Apollo, Lemlist
  • Instructional design or adult learning
  • LMS and community platforms: Circle, Teachable, Skilljar
  • Portuguese, French, or Spanish fluency


Details

  • R$14,700 to R$20,600 per month, plus an end-of-year bonus
  • Two recordings of trainings you have delivered in English, requested with your application
  • Professional English (only English CVs will be considered)


About WeTransact

Most companies in our space raise tens of millions and burn it chasing this market. We bootstrapped, turned a profit, and built the software that 500+ companies now use to sell through Microsoft. Titles don't matter here. Accountability does, and so does winning as a team.

title: Global Payroll & Compensation Specialist
description:
TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software. Our TurnKey team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! With over 300+ employees across Eastern Europe and Latin America (including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Uruguay, and Venezuela), we are dedicated to scaling remote software development teams for more than 40 U.S. -based enterprises and startups, such as Ripple, Headspace, Carnegie, Flywire, YipitData, Niche, and BellXcel.

We are looking for a skilled Global Payroll and Compensation Manager to join our Finance team and take ownership of global payroll and compensation operations for employees and contractors.

This role is critical to ensuring accurate, timely, and compliant payroll execution while supporting the company’s financial operations in a fully remote, international environment.


Key Responsibilities

  • Manage end-to-end global payroll processes for employees and contractors as part of the Finance function
  • Ensure accurate calculation and timely payment of salaries, bonuses, reimbursements, and other compensation components
  • Review and validate time-tracking data prior to payroll processing
  • Coordinate, review, and approve benefits-related requests in collaboration with HR and external providers
  • Process payroll-related payments via banks and international payment systems
  • Partner with EOR providers to manage payroll operations across multiple countries
  • Act as a key Finance team contact for payroll and compensation-related inquiries
  • Ensure payroll data accuracy, proper documentation, and confidentiality
  • Support financial reporting by providing payroll-related data and reconciliations
  • Collaborate closely with Legal, HR, and external partners to improve payroll and compensation processes


Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in payroll, compensation, or finance-related roles
  • Proven experience managing payroll for employees and contractors
  • Solid understanding of payroll processes within a Finance function
  • Experience working with banks and international payment systems
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills
  • Excellent attention to detail and high level of accuracy
  • Good command of English (written and spoken)


Nice to Have

  • Experience working with EOR (Employer of Record) services
  • Background in EOR and recruitment services
  • Experience using QuickBooks
  • Experience supporting payroll in global, remote-first companies


What We Offer

  • Full-time remote role with flexible working arrangements
  • Opportunity to work in a global, fast-growing environment
  • Collaboration with international teams and partners
  • Competitive compensation package



Kindly submit your up-to-date CV in English.

title: Veterinary Radiologist
description:
Veterinary Radiologist - Remote


About SignalPET


SignalPET is a pioneering technology company reshaping veterinary medicine through AI-powered radiograph interpretation. Our mission is to provide fast, accurate, and accessible diagnostic insights to veterinarians around the world.


Role Overview


We are seeking experienced Veterinary Radiologists based in Brazil to join us. In this 100% remote role, you will review AI-assisted radiographic studies, validate findings, and support clinical quality initiatives. This is a unique chance to combine your clinical expertise with innovative technology on a global scale.


Key Responsibilities


  • Review and interpret routine small-animal radiographic studies.
  • Validate the accuracy of AI-generated reports.

title: Accounting Manager – Remote (Work from anywhere)
description:
MAVI partners with high-growth US startups and SMEs, embedding experienced accounting professionals directly within their finance teams. In India, we are building finance leaders who go beyond execution and take ownership of teams, processes, and client outcomes.


This is not a traditional accounting manager role. You will lead accounting operations for US clients while mentoring and developing your team in a fast-moving environment.


The Opportunity

As an Accounting Manager, you will oversee end-to-end accounting operations for US clients, managing a team of accountants and working directly with US Controllers and CFOs. You will be a key finance partner responsible for accuracy, scalability, and continuous process improvement.


What You Will Own

  • Lead end-to-end accounting (Record-to-Report) for US clients
  • Manage and mentor a team of accountants ensuring quality and professional growth
  • Oversee month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close cycles
  • Review and finalize financial statements in compliance with US GAAP
  • Manage multi-location revenue accounting, COGS tracking, and operational expense reconciliations
  • Act as primary US client contact, building strong stakeholder relationships
  • Partner with Controllers and CFOs to support reporting and financial insights
  • Drive process automation and workflow improvements
  • Ensure audit readiness and manage auditor interactions


What We're Looking For

  • 6+ years of accounting experience with strong US GAAP expertise
  • Prior experience in team management or mentoring
  • Background in hospitality, restaurant tech, or multi-location businesses a strong plus
  • Strong understanding of close cycles, financial reporting, and internal controls
  • ERP experience (NetSuite, Toast, QuickBooks, or similar)
  • CA / CPA (or equivalent) strongly preferred
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Ability to work with US time zone overlap


Why Join MAVI?

  • Lead finance for some of the most exciting US companies
  • Build and manage high-performing accounting teams
  • High ownership and direct visibility with US leadership
  • Fast-track career path to Finance Controller and Head of Finance roles
  • Flexible remote work with global impact
  • Compensation in USD

title: Crypto Operations Specialist
description:
About us

Diversas Vagas is a recruitment agency working with companies in fintech, digital assets and online payments. We handle hiring for partners who need people with real technical experience, not just a matching keyword on a CV. This role is open at one of our partner companies, a digital asset business with a distributed team, and we are running the search and the first stages of the process.

About the role

Our partner is looking for a Crypto Operations Specialist to own their daily crypto operations. You will be the person responsible for making sure funds move correctly, safely and on time.

What you will do

  • Handle incoming and outgoing crypto transfers, conversions between assets, and movement of funds between wallets and exchange accounts.
  • Work with non-custodial wallets (MetaMask, Trust Wallet, Safe, hardware wallets) across several networks, including Ethereum, Tron, BNB Chain, Solana, Polygon and Arbitrum.
  • Manage company accounts on major exchanges: deposits and withdrawals, spot conversions, withdrawal limits, address whitelisting, account verification and support tickets.
  • Choose the right network for each transfer, check fees before sending, and run test transactions before larger amounts go out.
  • Monitor transactions through block explorers, confirm settlements, and investigate transfers that are delayed, stuck or failed.
  • Keep accurate records of every operation, reconcile wallet and exchange balances daily, and prepare regular reports for the finance team.
  • Follow and improve internal security procedures: seed phrase and key handling, hardware wallet use, two-factor authentication, access rights, separation of hot and cold storage.
  • Review operations for anything unusual, follow AML and KYC procedures, and escalate anything that looks wrong before it becomes a problem.
  • Work closely with finance, product and support. You will be the person other teams come to with questions about crypto payments, so clear communication matters here.
  • Help document the process. The company wants procedures written down, not kept in someone's head.

What we are looking for

  • At least 2 years of hands-on experience in crypto. This is not a role for someone who has only traded on the side.
  • Real practical experience with non-custodial wallets. You should be comfortable managing keys, setting up multisig, connecting to different networks and recovering access when something goes wrong.
  • Experience working with centralized exchanges, including withdrawals, deposits, verification and limits.
  • Solid understanding of crypto asset security and common attack methods: phishing, fake sites, address poisoning, malicious contract approvals.
  • Strong attention to detail. A wrong network or one wrong character in an address is money gone, and we need someone who checks twice by habit.
  • Ability to work independently, keep your own records in order and report clearly on what you did.
  • Working level of English for internal communication and exchange support.
  • Stable internet connection and your own computer.

Nice to have

  • Experience with DeFi protocols, bridges and stablecoin flows.
  • Familiarity with blockchain analytics tools such as Chainalysis or similar.
  • Previous work in fintech, payments or an exchange.
  • Confident with spreadsheets and basic reporting.

What the role offers

  • Salary: $240,000 – $270,000 per year
  • Paid vacation
  • Full medical insurance
  • Remote work with flexible hours, as long as key operations are covered
  • Equipment and hardware wallets covered by the company
  • Budget for professional courses and certifications
  • Small team, direct communication, no long approval chains

title: Analista Fiscal Júnior
description:
Sobre a oportunidade

Estamos ampliando nosso time fiscal e buscamos Analista Fiscal Júnior com autonomia para conduzir a apuração completa de uma carteira de clientes, atuando 100% remoto.

Buscamos alguém que já resolva sozinho as rotinas do dia a dia e consiga identificar inconsistências antes que virem problema para o cliente.


Responsabilidades

  • Condução completa da apuração fiscal de carteira própria de clientes
  • Análise e revisão de escrituração fiscal de entradas e saídas
  • Apuração e conferência de ICMS, ICMS-ST, ISS, PIS, COFINS, IPI, IRPJ e CSLL
  • Transmissão de todas as obrigações acessórias federais, estaduais e municipais
  • Revisão de enquadramento tributário e análise de cenários de regime

title: ESPECIALISTA DE DADOS
description:
Cargo: ESPECIALISTA DE DADOS


Já pensou em trabalhar em uma das maiores empresas de Tecnologia do Brasil?

Então a CAST é o lugar certo para você! 😉


Todas as nossas vagas são afirmativas 🦼✊ 🤱 ️ !!!


Local de Atuação: Brasil

Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto


O QUE BUSCAMOS

Estamos em busca de um profissional responsável por projetar, implantar e operar a infraestrutura de nuvem que sustenta a plataforma de dados, garantindo conectividade, identidade, armazenamento, criptografia, disponibilidade, observabilidade e controle de custos, com atuação em ambientes híbridos AWS e on-premises.


Que possua conhecimentos e experiências em:

✔️ Domínio de fundamentos AWS, incluindo redes, IAM, armazenamento, criptografia, monitoramento, alta disponibilidade, backup e recuperação;

✔️ Experiência com Infraestrutura como Código (IaC), preferencialmente Terraform, gestão de estado, módulos reutilizáveis e pipelines de mudanças;

✔️ Conhecimentos sólidos de TCP/IP, DNS, roteamento, firewalls, proxies, balanceadores, VPN/Direct Connect e troubleshooting de conectividade;

✔️ Experiência com práticas de segurança em nuvem, incluindo menor privilégio, segregação de funções, gestão de segredos, rotação de credenciais e hardening;

✔️ Administração de ambientes AWS utilizados pelo Databricks, incluindo VPCs, subnets, security groups, S3, IAM Roles, KMS, PrivateLink e endpoints privados;

✔️ Experiência com automação de provisionamento de workspaces e recursos compartilhados utilizando Terraform, com separação por órgão e ambiente;

✔️ Conhecimento em conectividade híbrida com bancos Oracle e outros serviços on-premises, incluindo proxies, rotas, resolução de nomes e monitoramento de disponibilidade;

✔️ Experiência na gestão de credenciais e identidades técnicas utilizadas por pipelines, service principals e integrações entre Azure DevOps, Databricks e AWS;

✔️ Conhecimento em observabilidade de infraestrutura, incluindo alertas, logs, métricas e runbooks de resposta;

✔️ Conhecimento em FinOps, incluindo tagging, budgets, análise de consumo, right-sizing e identificação de desperdícios em computação, armazenamento e tráfego;

✔️ Experiência ou conhecimento em migração de componentes on-premises e Kubernetes/Rancher para serviços em nuvem, garantindo continuidade e segurança.


BENEFÍCIOS PARA TODOS

Recarregue suas energias com o auxílio-alimentação.

🚘 Facilitamos seu caminho para o trabalho com o vale-transporte.

🚑 Cuidar de você é nosso compromisso: plano de saúde para sua tranquilidade.

Cuidar de quem cuida é essencial! Com o Programa Baby CAST, nossas mamães recebem um Kit Maternidade CASTLOVERS, preparado com carinho para celebrar a chegada do bebê. (Benefício disponível para vagas elegíveis.)


BENEFÍCIOS PARA VOCÊ ESCOLHER

🦷 Sorria com confiança: nosso plano odontológico cuida do seu bem-estar bucal.

⚕️ Cuide da sua saúde com mais praticidade: com o Dr. Alper, você tem acesso a teleconsultas sem coparticipação, cashback na compra de medicamentos e mapeamento de saúde.

🩺 Com o Starbem, você e até quatro dependentes contam com teleconsultas gratuitas com psicólogos, nutricionistas, clínico geral e médicos especialistas.

️ ♀️ Transforme seu bem-estar: com Wellhub, você tem acesso a academias e atividades físicas em todo lugar.

🧠 Seu bem-estar mental é nossa prioridade: apoio psicológico disponível.

Seja seu melhor com nossas iniciativas de bem-estar. Nos escritórios da CAST, disponibilizamos frutas para tornar a rotina mais leve e saudável.

Aproveite nosso crédito consignado para realizar seus sonhos com segurança e praticidade.

Com o Clube de Descontos economize mais com nossos descontos exclusivos para colaboradores.


E TEM MAIS! DESENVOLVA SUA CARREIRA

Temos a CAST Academy recheada de cursos on-line, e parcerias educacionais para cursos de Graduação e Idiomas (United Idiomas) com super descontos.


E aí, topa ser um #CASTLOVER ?

Cargo: ESPECIALISTA DE DADOS


Já pensou em trabalhar em uma das maiores empresas de Tecnologia do Brasil?

Então a CAST é o lugar certo para você! 😉


Todas as nossas vagas são afirmativas 🦼✊ 🤱 ️ !!!


Local de Atuação: Brasil

Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto


O QUE BUSCAMOS

Estamos em busca de um profissional responsável por projetar, implantar e operar a infraestrutura de nuvem que sustenta a plataforma de dados, garantindo conectividade, identidade, armazenamento, criptografia, disponibilidade, observabilidade e controle de custos, com atuação em ambientes híbridos AWS e on-premises.


Que possua conhecimentos e experiências em:

✔️ Domínio de fundamentos AWS, incluindo redes, IAM, armazenamento, criptografia, monitoramento, alta disponibilidade, backup e recuperação;

✔️ Experiência com Infraestrutura como Código (IaC), preferencialmente Terraform, gestão de estado, módulos reutilizáveis e pipelines de mudanças;

✔️ Conhecimentos sólidos de TCP/IP, DNS, roteamento, firewalls, proxies, balanceadores, VPN/Direct Connect e troubleshooting de conectividade;

✔️ Experiência com práticas de segurança em nuvem, incluindo menor privilégio, segregação de funções, gestão de segredos, rotação de credenciais e hardening;

✔️ Administração de ambientes AWS utilizados pelo Databricks, incluindo VPCs, subnets, security groups, S3, IAM Roles, KMS, PrivateLink e endpoints privados;

✔️ Experiência com automação de provisionamento de workspaces e recursos compartilhados utilizando Terraform, com separação por órgão e ambiente;

✔️ Conhecimento em conectividade híbrida com bancos Oracle e outros serviços on-premises, incluindo proxies, rotas, resolução de nomes e monitoramento de disponibilidade;

✔️ Experiência na gestão de credenciais e identidades técnicas utilizadas por pipelines, service principals e integrações entre Azure DevOps, Databricks e AWS;

✔️ Conhecimento em observabilidade de infraestrutura, incluindo alertas, logs, métricas e runbooks de resposta;

✔️ Conhecimento em FinOps, incluindo tagging, budgets, análise de consumo, right-sizing e identificação de desperdícios em computação, armazenamento e tráfego;

✔️ Experiência ou conhecimento em migração de componentes on-premises e Kubernetes/Rancher para serviços em nuvem, garantindo continuidade e segurança.


BENEFÍCIOS PARA TODOS

Recarregue suas energias com o auxílio-alimentação.

🚘 Facilitamos seu caminho para o trabalho com o vale-transporte.

🚑 Cuidar de você é nosso compromisso: plano de saúde para sua tranquilidade.

Cuidar de quem cuida é essencial! Com o Programa Baby CAST, nossas mamães recebem um Kit Maternidade CASTLOVERS, preparado com carinho para celebrar a chegada do bebê. (Benefício disponível para vagas elegíveis.)


BENEFÍCIOS PARA VOCÊ ESCOLHER

🦷 Sorria com confiança: nosso plano odontológico cuida do seu bem-estar bucal.

⚕️ Cuide da sua saúde com mais praticidade: com o Dr. Alper, você tem acesso a teleconsultas sem coparticipação, cashback na compra de medicamentos e mapeamento de saúde.

🩺 Com o Starbem, você e até quatro dependentes contam com teleconsultas gratuitas com psicólogos, nutricionistas, clínico geral e médicos especialistas.

️ ♀️ Transforme seu bem-estar: com Wellhub, você tem acesso a academias e atividades físicas em todo lugar.

🧠 Seu bem-estar mental é nossa prioridade: apoio psicológico disponível.

Seja seu melhor com nossas iniciativas de bem-estar. Nos escritórios da CAST, disponibilizamos frutas para tornar a rotina mais leve e saudável.

Aproveite nosso crédito consignado para realizar seus sonhos com segurança e praticidade.

Com o Clube de Descontos economize mais com nossos descontos exclusivos para colaboradores.


E TEM MAIS! DESENVOLVA SUA CARREIRA

Temos a CAST Academy recheada de cursos on-line, e parcerias educacionais para cursos de Graduação e Idiomas (United Idiomas) com super descontos.


E aí, topa ser um #CASTLOVER ?

title: Senior Business Analyst / Arquiteto de Soluções SAP S/4HANA Cloud
description:
🚀 Senior Business Analyst / Arquiteto de Soluções SAP S/4HANA Cloud


São Paulo/SP (Onboarding presencial em SP, não contempla reembolso de despesas)

Atuação remota após integração/Onboarding


Responsabilidades

  • Conduzir workshops e reuniões com as áreas de negócio para levantamento de requisitos.
  • Mapear processos atuais e identificar oportunidades de padronização no SAP S/4HANA Cloud.
  • Realizar análises Fit-Gap e reduzir dependências de customizações.
  • Elaborar RFPs, documentação funcional e escopos de projetos.
  • Atuar como ponte entre usuários, consultores SAP e equipes de tecnologia.
  • Apoiar a definição de soluções alinhadas às melhores práticas SAP.


Requisitos

✅ Experiência sólida como Business Analyst, Solution Architect ou Consultor SAP Sênior .

✅ Experiência em projetos de SAP S/4HANA Cloud .

✅ Forte conhecimento de processos de negócio end-to-end.

✅ Vivência em levantamento de requisitos, workshops e interação com stakeholders.

✅ Experiência em elaboração de RFPs , documentação funcional e análises Fit-Gap.

✅ Conhecimento de SAP Best Practices e abordagem Clean Core .


Perfil

⭐ Forte senso de ownership.

⭐ Profissional autônomo, pragmático e consultivo.

⭐ Excelente comunicação com áreas usuárias.

⭐ Capacidade de influenciar e conduzir discussões de negócio.

⭐ Visão sistêmica e foco em simplificação de processos.

title: Assistente fiscal
description:
Sobre a oportunidade

Escritório contábil em fase de estruturação de equipe busca Assistente Fiscal com experiência prática em rotinas de escrituração e apuração para atuar de forma totalmente remota, atendendo carteira de clientes de diferentes portes e regimes tributários.

Esta é uma posição para quem já passou da fase de aprendizado inicial e quer consolidar carreira na área fiscal, com autonomia e possibilidade real de evolução para analista.


Responsabilidades

  • Escrituração de notas fiscais de entrada, saída e serviços
  • Apuração de impostos: ICMS, ISS, PIS, COFINS, IPI e Simples Nacional
  • Emissão e conferência de guias de recolhimento
  • Envio de obrigações acessórias: SPED Fiscal, EFD Contribuições, DCTFWeb, EFD-Reinf, GIA, DeSTDA e declarações municipais
  • Conferência e classificação fiscal de produtos e serviços
  • Atendimento e orientação aos clientes da carteira sobre rotinas fiscais
  • Organização e controle de prazos das obrigações mensais

    • Requisitos obrigatórios

    • Experiência mínima de 1 ano em rotinas fiscais, preferencialmente em escritório de contabilidade
    • Domínio de sistema contábil (Domínio/Thomson Reuters, Alterdata, Questor, Contmatic, Sage ou equivalente)
    • Conhecimento prático dos regimes Simples Nacional e Lucro Presumido
    • Excel em nível intermediário
    • Ensino superior cursando ou concluído em Ciências Contábeis, Gestão Tributária ou áreas correlatas
    • Estrutura para trabalho remoto: internet estável e ambiente adequado


    Diferenciais

    • Vivência com Lucro Real
    • Experiência com clientes de e-commerce ou substituição tributária
    • Conhecimento de reforma tributária (CBS e IBS)


    O que oferecemos

    • Trabalho 100% remoto, sem necessidade de deslocamento
    • Salário de R$ 2.200 a R$ 3.000, conforme experiência comprovada
    • Plano de carreira estruturado com trilha para Analista Fiscal
    • Ambiente organizado, com processos definidos e suporte técnico
    • Contratação CLT

    Se você tem experiência fiscal e busca estabilidade em um time que está crescendo, candidate-se.

title: Analista de Departamento Pessoal Júnior
description:
Sobre a oportunidade

Escritório contábil em expansão busca Analista de Departamento Pessoal Júnior para conduzir com autonomia a folha de pagamento de uma carteira própria de clientes, atuando 100% remoto.


Procuramos alguém que já domine o ciclo completo de DP, do admissional ao rescisório, e que saiba interpretar convenções coletivas sem depender de validação a cada passo. Se você já é assistente de DP e quer dar o próximo passo com carteira própria, esta vaga foi desenhada para você.


Responsabilidades

  • Condução completa da folha de pagamento de carteira própria de clientes
  • Admissões, rescisões, cálculos rescisórios e homologações
  • Apuração e fechamento mensal de folha, incluindo conferência e validação de eventos
  • Cálculo e provisionamento de férias e 13º salário
  • Emissão e conferência de guias: FGTS Digital, DARF previdenciário, IRRF e contribuições sindicais
  • Transmissão e monitoramento de eventos no eSocial, com tratamento de inconsistências e retornos
  • Entrega de DCTFWeb e obrigações acessórias trabalhistas
  • Aplicação de convenções e acordos coletivos de diferentes categorias
  • Controle de ponto, banco de horas e escalas
  • Atendimento consultivo ao cliente sobre legislação trabalhista e impactos em folha
  • Apoio técnico e revisão do trabalho de assistentes da equipe


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência mínima de 2 anos em rotinas completas de departamento pessoal

title: Director of Strategic Partnerships
description:
ABOUT ELIFE

Elife is the unified API infrastructure behind global mobility and instant delivery across 182 countries. We power Super Apps, FinTechs, neobanks, and ride-hailing ecosystems worldwide — we don't compete with them, we enable them. Our partners integrate once and serve their users globally. We build and operate the infrastructure. Our partners own the brand and the customer relationship. We do not compete for our partners' users.


THE ROLE

We are looking for a proven ecosystem hunter — not an account manager, not a loyalty program builder, not a co-marketing specialist. Someone who has personally closed bidirectional commercial deals where both parties share live transaction revenue, through API integrations with super apps, neobanks, fintech platforms, or mobility companies.

This is a greenfield, individual contributor role. You will build elife's LATAM pipeline from zero, own the full deal lifecycle from outreach to signed contract, and be expected to deliver active pipeline within the first 90 days.


WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Identify, engage and close strategic partnerships with super apps, neobanks, fintech platforms, ride-hailing operators and e-commerce ecosystems across LATAM
  • Own the full commercial lifecycle — outreach, negotiation, deal structuring, contract execution and partner onboarding
  • Structure and close revenue-share and API integration agreements where elife's infrastructure powers mobility and delivery services inside a partner's platform
  • Build and maintain 20+ active enterprise prospects at any given time
  • Engage C-suite and VP-level decision makers directly — no intermediaries
  • Represent elife at industry events and forums across LATAM
  • Report pipeline, forecasts and market intelligence directly to the VP of Partnerships


WHAT WE NEED — NON-NEGOTIABLE

  • 8+ years of B2B enterprise partnerships experience
  • Minimum 3 years of direct experience closing ecosystem deals with or inside super apps, neobanks, fintech platforms, or ride-hailing companies in LATAM
  • Proven track record closing bidirectional revenue-share deals — where revenue is generated by live transactions, not loyalty points, discount campaigns or co-marketing budgets
  • Direct experience structuring and closing API integration partnerships commercially — owning the business case, commercial terms and deal execution end-to-end
  • Active C-suite network verifiable with specific names in at least two of the following: Rappi, Uber, DiDi, MercadoPago, Nu, Clip, Stori, Kavak, iFood or equivalent LATAM super apps or neobanks
  • Multi-country LATAM experience — Mexico and/or Brazil required; Colombia, Argentina, Chile a plus
  • Hunter DNA — you have built pipelines from zero, not inherited them
  • Fluency in Spanish and/or Portuguese required; English proficiency required
  • Bachelor's degree minimum; MBA strongly preferred


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Prior experience working with or for mobility platforms, ride-hailing operators, corporate travel or fleet technology companies
  • Track record closing first-of-kind or complex ecosystem partnerships with measurable commercial outcomes
  • Experience managing partnerships across multiple LATAM countries simultaneously
  • Familiarity with the regulatory and payments landscape across Brazil, Mexico and Colombia


WHAT WE OFFER

  • Fixed monthly base + KPI bonus scalable up to 300% based on commercial results
  • Uncapped commissions tied directly to the revenue you generate
  • Remote-first with regional travel as required
  • Direct access to C-suite and founder leadership from day one
  • A genuinely entrepreneurial environment where your deals shape elife's growth trajectory in LATAM


MARKET CONTEXT

Latin America is one of the fastest-growing digital financial services markets in the world, led by Brazil and Mexico. The region is home to a dynamic ecosystem of super apps, neobanks, and ride-hailing operators actively seeking scalable mobility and delivery partnerships. The Director of Strategic Partnerships for LATAM will build elife's presence from the ground up in this high-potential, relationship-driven market — and earn accordingly.

title: Senior AI Agent Engineer
description:
About FirstIgnite

FirstIgnite makes software for university tech transfer offices. Those are the people who take research

coming out of a university lab and get it patented, licensed, or spun out into a company.


The role

We're hiring a Senior AI Agent Engineer. You'll build the agents in our product, and you'll build the

evals that tell us whether each change made them better or worse.

The work is document-heavy rather than chat. The agents run multi-step, call tools, read long and

inconsistently formatted source material, check it against existing records, and produce output that a

person reviews before anything happens with it.

Accuracy matters more here than speed or novelty. Most of the engineering effort goes into precision,

traceability, and getting the agent to hand off to a human at the right moment.

You'll report to the Head of Engineering and work with product and the full-stack team. If you've

shipped agents before, you've probably had the experience of changing a prompt and having no idea

whether you improved anything. That problem is most of this job.


What you'll do

• Design and ship long-running, multi-step, tool-using agents on various AI SDKs and tooling,

included but not limited to the OpenAI Agents SDK, the Anthropic Agent SDK, the Vercel AI SDK,

LangGraph, MCP, and Temporal Cloud.

• Wrap our APIs and our partners' APIs as tools an agent can call over MCP. Some of those systems

are old, single-tenant, and outside our control, so a fair amount of the work is translation.

• Get structured data out of long documents and match it against records that already exist. Expect

entity resolution and fuzzy matching, and expect much of it to run in batch.

• Stand up eval suites using various evaluation frameworks and tooling, included but not limited to

Promptfoo, Braintrust, LangSmith, DeepEval, LLM-as-judge methods, and custom harnesses.

Measure tool-use correctness, trajectory quality, and whether the agent finished the task.

• Every agent here produces a draft that a person signs off on. Build the citations and confidence

signals that make that review fast, and give the agent a clear way to escalate.

• Sit with product and domain experts and turn vague quality goals into something measurable.

Sometimes the only dataset available for that is tiny, or confidential, or both.

• Instrument production traffic, turn real customer interactions into golden datasets, and run them as

regression tests.

• Compare models against each other (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-weight), along with prompt

strategies and agent designs, and know what each option costs in latency and quality.

• Bootstrap quality signal for features that have no production traffic yet. That usually means

generating synthetic documents and test cases, including the ugly edge cases real customers will

eventually send us, and knowing where synthetic data stops being a good proxy.

• Write the templates, docs, and tooling the rest of the team needs to run evals without coming to

you.


Required Qualifications:

• 3+ years of engineering experience, including hands-on work on LLM or agent systems that real

users touched.

• You've evaluated agents, not only models, and you know why single-turn accuracy says little about

a multi-step run.

• You've integrated against APIs you don't own, including old ones with bad documentation, and

turned them into something an agent can call reliably.

• You're comfortable with document pipelines: pulling data out, normalizing it, and checking it against

a structured source of truth.

• You've used at least one LLM evaluation framework, in-house tooling included.

• You know how LLM-as-judge methods break down (position bias, verbosity bias, judge drift) and

what to do about it.

title: Junior Spanish Recruiter
description:
Location: São Paulo, SP or Bragança Paulista, SP

Work Model: Hybrid or Remote


About the Role

We are looking for a Junior Recruiter to join our team and support our staffing and outsourcing operations .


This role is ideal for someone who is building a career in recruitment and enjoys connecting with people, identifying talent, and building candidate relationships . You will support recruitment processes for international clients and candidates, with a strong focus on the Spanish-speaking market .


What You'll Do

  • Source and build pipelines of qualified candidates.
  • Conduct initial candidate screenings and interviews.
  • Review resumes and assess candidates against job requirements.
  • Conduct outreach through calls, messages, and other sourcing channels.
  • Maintain accurate candidate information in our internal systems.
  • Partner with recruiters and hiring managers to support hiring needs.
  • Work toward weekly recruitment activity and productivity goals.


What We're Looking For

  • Fluent English and Spanish .
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to build relationships and confidently speak with candidates.
  • Good organization and attention to detail.
  • Comfortable working with activity goals and recruitment targets.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office.
  • High motivation and interest in developing a career in recruitment.


Nice to Have

  • Previous experience in recruitment, sourcing, HR, customer service, or sales .
  • Experience recruiting for the Spanish-speaking market .
  • Familiarity with LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, or ATS platforms .
  • Experience in staffing, outsourcing, or international recruitment.


If you're energetic, people-oriented, and ready to grow your career in recruitment, we'd love to hear from you!

title: Electrical BIM/VDC Coordinator
description:
At Consultores de Empresas , we are looking for an Electrical BIM/VDC Coordinator !

We are seeking a professional with experience in BIM/VDC, electrical modeling, and construction project coordination to join a team working on highly complex commercial projects.


Key Responsibilities

  • Interpret and analyze construction documentation for electrical systems.
  • Design and model conduit systems according to design and constructability criteria.
  • Develop and manage LOD 400 electrical models in Revit .
  • Perform clash detection and resolution using Navisworks and Revizto .
  • Coordinate the electrical model with different disciplines and project teams.
  • Produce sleeve drawings, embedded points, and coordinate shop drawings.
  • Ensure model accuracy and compliance with applicable codes.
  • Resolve modeling issues and provide technical solutions.
  • Support field operations through remote coordination.
  • Occasionally collaborate on mechanical/MEP and process piping modeling tasks.


Requirements

  • Minimum 3 years of experience in BIM/VDC and construction modeling .
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in electrical project coordination .
  • Experience in electrical trades/installations.
  • Revit mandatory , with strong experience in detailed electrical modeling.
  • Experience working with LOD 350–400 electrical models .
  • Experience interpreting construction documentation.
  • Knowledge of Navisworks and/or Revizto .
  • Knowledge of AutoCAD and BIM 360 is a plus.
  • Understanding of MEP systems and their integration into modeling workflows.
  • Strong problem-solving and coordination skills.
  • Good communication skills and ability to work collaboratively in remote environments.


Project Experience

Experience in the following projects is a plus:

  • ️ Data Centers / Critical Infrastructure
  • Healthcare Facilities
  • Educational Institutions
  • Semiconductor Manufacturing Plants
  • Commercial and Retail Projects


We Are Looking For Someone Who Has

  • Excellent communication and strong remote work capabilities.
  • A proactive and autonomous approach.
  • Strong problem-solving skills.
  • Attention to detail and a strong focus on quality.
  • Ability to work with minimal supervision.
  • Interest in adopting new tools and industry practices.


Location: Latin America | Remote

If you have experience in BIM/VDC and electrical modeling in Revit , we want to hear from you!
