title: Remote M&A Lawyer - Brazil
description:
About Moritz


Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.


We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.


We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.


Moritz has raised a $9M seed round from Y Combinator, 20VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.


The Role


  • Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's M&A work in Brazil: share and asset deals, mergers, carve-outs, and joint ventures for clients ranging from startups to midsize companies.
  • Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of SPAs and APAs, disclosure schedules, warranties and indemnities, and ancillary transaction documents.
  • Run legal due diligence, coordinate specialist workstreams (tax, employment, IP, regulatory), and manage the transaction timeline through signing and closing.
  • Advise on deal structuring, earn-outs and deferred consideration, W&I insurance, closing mechanics, and post-closing matters.
  • If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.


What You'll Bring


  • 5+ years practising M&A or corporate law in private practice or in-house.
  • End-to-end deal experience. You've led transactions from term sheet through closing, not just supported workstreams.
  • Deep familiarity with transaction documents — SPAs, APAs, disclosure letters, warranty and indemnity regimes, and completion mechanics.
  • Due diligence command. You can scope, run, and synthesize a diligence exercise into findings a buyer can act on.
  • Cross-border fluency. Comfortable coordinating with counsel in other jurisdictions on multi-country deals.
  • Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.


Why Moritz


  • Run deals with modern tooling — faster diligence, cleaner documents, and clients who value speed and certainty.
  • Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice.
  • Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity.
  • Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.


Frequently Asked Questions


How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?


Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.


What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?


Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.


Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?


No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.


How are co-counsel matched to client matters?


Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms

  • Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's M&A work in Brazil: share and asset deals, mergers, carve-outs, and joint ventures for clients ranging from startups to midsize companies.
  • Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of SPAs and APAs, disclosure schedules, warranties and indemnities, and ancillary transaction documents.
  • Run legal due diligence, coordinate specialist workstreams (tax, employment, IP, regulatory), and manage the transaction timeline through signing and closing.
  • Advise on deal structuring, earn-outs and deferred consideration, W&I insurance, closing mechanics, and post-closing matters.

title: Account Manager
description:
We're Convert Sail, an e-commerce conversion optimization agency. We work with Shopify brands spending $100K-$1M+/month on ads, and we move fast. Really fast.


We're looking for an Account Manager to own client relationships and project delivery. You'll manage 8-10 client accounts, coordinate landing page and funnel builds with our design and dev team, and be the main point of contact when clients need something.


This isn't a 9-5 role where you clock out and forget about work. When a client has a launch on Saturday, you're online. When a project is behind, you stay late to fix it. We ship fast, we work weekends when it matters, and most people flame out in the first 90 days because they can't handle the pace.


If that scares you, this isn't the role for you.


If that excites you, keep reading.


What you'll do:


  • Own 8-10 client relationships and make sure they're happy, on track, and renewing long-term
  • Manage day-to-day client communication and set clear expectations
  • Coordinate landing page and funnel projects with our design and dev team—keep timelines tight and make sure nothing slips
  • Proactively identify and solve client issues before they become fires
  • Track project progress in ClickUp and ensure deadlines are met
  • Help clients see ROI from our work so they stick around for 6-12+ months, not 2-3
  • Be available during USA business hours and occasionally on weekends when client launches require it


What we're looking for:


  • 2+ years of experience managing client accounts in a fast-paced agency, SaaS company, or startup
  • Fluent English speaker with strong written and verbal communication skills
  • You've worked in high-pressure environments before and didn't crack under the weight
  • You're organized, proactive, and don't need someone checking in on you every 2 hours
  • You don't let things fall through the cracks—you follow up, you track details, you close loops
  • Experience with project management tools like ClickUp, Asana, or similar
  • Comfortable working remotely, but you don't treat \"remote\" like \"invisible\"
  • Bonus: Experience with e-commerce, Shopify, or conversion optimization (not required, but helpful)


What we offer:


  • Compensation: $12/hour ($2,000+/month full-time) + performance bonuses (depending on experience)
  • Fully remote—work from anywhere as long as you're available US hours
  • Work with real scaling brands, not broke startups or tire-kickers
  • Small team, so you'll have real impact and visibility
  • You'll learn more in 6 months here than 2 years at a slow-moving corporate job
  • Opportunity to grow into a senior role as the agency scales


How to apply:


Don't send a resume first.


Record a 4-minute Loom video (free tool, Google it if you don't know it) and tell us:


  • Why you want this job
  • Why we should hire you
  • A time you had to manage a difficult client situation and how you handled it


Then email the Loom link to:


Subject line must include the word BUILDER. If it doesn't, we'll assume you can't follow instructions and we won't read your application.


If you can't handle recording a 4-minute video, you definitely can't handle this role.

title: Strategy & Operations Manager
description:
About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 80+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.


About the role

At Revolut, Operations means problem-solving at scale. Our team tackles the company’s toughest challenges with speed, precision, and creativity. They design systems that unlock efficiency and power global growth.

We're looking for a Strategy & Operations Manager to help shape how we continue to expand and operate across the globe. You’ll work on high-impact initiatives throughout the business, using insight to solve challenges, scale processes, and deliver better outcomes for our customers.

Watch this video from our team members about what goes into being a Strategy & Operations Manager at Revolut.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let’s get in touch.


What you’ll be doing

title: Remote Real Estate Lawyer - Brazil
description:
About Moritz


Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.


We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.


We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.


Moritz has raised a $9M seed round from Y Combinator, 20VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.


The Role


  • Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's real estate work in Brazil: commercial leases, sale and purchase agreements, real estate aspects of corporate transactions, and development and construction agreements.
  • Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of leases and property transaction documents for clients ranging from startups taking their first office to enterprises managing property portfolios.
  • Run title review and property due diligence, including for real estate elements of M&A and financing transactions.
  • Advise on real estate financing and security, planning and zoning questions, and landlord-tenant matters.
  • If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.


What You'll Bring


  • 5+ years practising commercial real estate law in private practice or in-house.
  • Leasing depth. Office, retail, industrial, and flexible-space leases — rent review, service charges, repair obligations, break options, and assignments.
  • Transactional experience. Sale and purchase agreements, title review and due diligence, conditions, and completion mechanics.
  • Financing familiarity. Mortgages, security packages, and the real estate workstreams of corporate deals.
  • Practical judgment. You separate the points that protect the client from the points that stall the deal.
  • Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.


Why Moritz


  • Bring speed and clarity to real estate transactions traditionally slowed by process.
  • Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice.
  • Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity.
  • Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.


Frequently Asked Questions


How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?


Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.


What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?


Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.


Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?


No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.


How are co-counsel matched to client matters?


Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms

title: Senior DTC Video Editor
description:
We are a leading brand in health supplements for women over 40. Our mission is to improve the quality of life for women going through menopause by solving real, everyday challenges—weight gain, hot flashes, insomnia, mood shifts, and more.


We’re looking for a Senior DTC Video Editor to join our team full-time and help us create high-performing Meta video ads for our e-commerce brand.


What you’ll do:

  • Edit performance-driven DTC/Meta ads
  • Lead, train, and support a team of video editors
  • Review editors’ work and provide feedback
  • Help improve our editing processes and creative output
  • Have a calls with your team + video editing team


Requirements:

  • Strong experience editing DTC / Meta ads
  • Previous experience leading or training video editors
  • Strong understanding of direct-response creative
  • Excellent attention to detail and creative judgment
  • Full-time availability: 6 AM–2 PM EST
  • Experience with wellness or supplement brands is a big plus


IMPORTANT:

  • You must provide a portfolio showing Meta ads you personally edited.
  • Location: South America, Europe


Please also include:

  • Number of editors you’ve led/trained
  • DTC/e-commerce brands you’ve worked with
  • Your Meta ad editing experience Applications without relevant Meta ad examples will not be considered.


Resume must be in English.

title: Supervisor(a) de Relacionamento com o Cliente
description:
Olá, somos a SuperFrete :)


Queremos ser a maior e mais amada rede de logística digital, quer fazer parte disso?


Somos uma startup que atua no segmento do varejo e logística, apoiando os pequenos e médios empreendedores a se tornarem mais competitivos no mercado e a alavancarem suas vendas. Por isso, buscamos um Super Supervisor(a) de Relacionamento com o Cliente , que se identifique com o nosso propósito, que tenha muita energia para somar no time de Operações e que queira crescer (muito!) com a gente.


Responsabilidades

  • Liderar, acompanhar e desenvolver o time de Relacionamento com o Cliente (Customer Service), promovendo engajamento e alta performance;
  • Acompanhar os principais indicadores da operação, como CSAT, TMPR e TMT, identificando desvios e conduzindo planos de ação;
  • Gerenciar a produtividade e a capacidade operacional, garantindo eficiência e fluidez no atendimento;
  • Monitorar o desempenho da IA de atendimento e dos fluxos da plataforma, identificando oportunidades de melhoria;
  • Realizar alinhamentos, 1:1 e feedbacks, apoiando o desenvolvimento das pessoas e a evolução do time;
  • Atuar na priorização de demandas e na resolução de problemas junto a outras áreas;
  • Conduzir processos seletivos e apoiar o onboarding e a integração de novas pessoas;
  • Analisar dados e apresentar os resultados da operação, consolidando indicadores e planos de ação para os acompanhamentos semanais e mensais.


Requisitos

  • Experiência em operações de atendimento ao cliente nos canais de chat e e-mail;
  • Experiência com liderança de equipes compostas majoritariamente por profissionais juniores e estagiários;
  • Experiência no acompanhamento de indicadores operacionais e gestão de performance;
  • Forte capacidade analítica e habilidade para utilizar dados na tomada de decisão;
  • Experiência com gestão de produtividade, capacidade operacional e rotinas de atendimento;
  • Vivência em gestão de pessoas, incluindo 1:1, feedbacks, desenvolvimento e acompanhamento de performance;
  • Experiência na contratação, integração e desenvolvimento de novos colaboradores;
  • Familiaridade com plataformas de atendimento e ferramentas de gestão operacional;
  • Conhecimento intermediário em Google Sheets ou Excel para acompanhamento e análise de indicadores;
  • Experiência com dashboards e acompanhamento de KPIs;
  • Perfil orientado à melhoria contínua, resolução de problemas e eficiência operacional.


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência em startups, empresas de tecnologia, marketplaces ou empresas de logística;
  • Experiência com Customer Experience (CX) e indicadores de satisfação, como CSAT e NPS;
  • Experiência com operações que utilizam IA e automação no atendimento;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de Business Intelligence, como Looker Studio ou Power BI;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de IA Generativa aplicadas à produtividade, análise de dados e operações;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de atendimento e gestão de tickets, como HubSpot ou similares.


O que você pode esperar dos Supers?

  • Uma cultura de muita confiança, colaboração, focada em resultados, com muita autonomia e transparência;
  • Buscamos excelência em tudo o que fazemos, por isso estamos sempre aprendendo;
  • Temos vontade de construir junto, fazer a diferença e gerar impacto.


O que oferecemos:

  • 🧾Modelo de contratação: PJ;
  • Modelo de trabalho 100% remoto: uma oportunidade de crescimento acessível para talentos em todo o Brasil;
  • ⚕ Plano de Saúde: mantenha-se saudável com nosso abrangente plano de saúde nacional com consultas online e presenciais;
  • ♀️GymPass/Wellhub: bem-estar completo para você cuidar da sua saúde física e mental com os aplicativos integrados;
  • Voucher Kit Escritório: receba um voucher para turbinar o seu espaço de trabalho e garantir seu conforto, comodidade e produtividade;
  • Férias remuneradas: desfrute de 30 dias de férias remuneradas por ano para recarregar suas energias e relaxar;
  • Programa Super-Get-Super: indique um talento e receba um bônus;
  • 😊Cultura colaborativa: nossa cultura é baseada na confiança, parceria e foco em resultados. Oferecemos um ambiente com autonomia e transparência;
  • Incentivo ao desenvolvimento: estamos comprometidos com a excelência e o aprendizado contínuo. Oferecemos avaliações semestrais, conversas de one-on-one, feedbacks construtivos, e muito mais;
  • Programa de Stock Option: possibilidade de se tornar sócio da empresa e participar diretamente do nosso crescimento. Somos reconhecidos como uma das startups mais promissoras do Brasil pela lista 100 Startups to Watch.



E aí, vamos juntos nesse SuperFoguete? 🚀

About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 80+ million customers get more from their money every day.


As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people.


People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.



About the role

Financial Crime Operations is at the forefront of Revolut’s efforts to keep customers and their money safe. Team members work directly with customers to resolve issues and flag potential concerns. Using cutting-edge technology and sharp attention to detail, they help prevent financial crime and keep trust at the core of Revolut.


We’re looking for a Financial Crime Analyst to identify suspicious activity and ensure we’re treating customers fairly. You’ll be investigating internal SARs and complex cases by applying judgement, analytical skills, and solid decision-making to identify where grounds for suspicion of money laundering exist.


To support our 24/7 coverage, this role may include night and weekend shifts, which are fully compensated.


Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.



What you'll be doing

  • Reviewing, investigating, and reporting financial crime cases
  • Providing ongoing monitoring and resolving formal complaints and Financial Ombudsman Service complaints
  • Dealing appropriately with consent refusals following SAR submissions
  • Acting as a point of contact for law enforcement agencies in ongoing criminal investigations that commenced from a submitted SAR
  • Acting in accordance with written policies, procedures, and relevant legislation
  • Cooperating with other teams by providing professional and efficient front-line compliance support, seeking to improve company processes



What you'll need

  • A bachelor's degree (must be able to provide a certificate)
  • 3+ years in financial crime investigations, or 1+ years of SAR reporting experience
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese (C1+ level)
  • Experience working in a regulated or policy-driven environment (e.g., financial institutions, law enforcement)
  • Experience with investigative methodologies, evidenced by the use of analytical tools (e.g., spreadsheets, filters, pivots, network charts)
  • The ability to work with multiple stakeholders and take ownership of assigned workload
  • Adaptability and experience with fast-cycle feedback
  • To be able to work a variety of shifts, including nights and weekends



Nice to have

  • Fluency in other languages
  • A degree in law or a STEM subject
  • A professional certification (e.g., ICA or ACAMS)
  • Familiarity with jurisdiction-specific financial regulations
  • Experience in crypto or blockchain analysis



Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday.


We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

description:
Senior AWS Cloud Infrastructure & Linux Engineer

Buscamos talento Senior AWS Cloud Infrastructure & Linux Engineer para atuar em um projeto estratégico de transformação e modernização de ambientes cloud corporativos. A posição exige forte experiência em AWS, Linux, automação de infraestrutura e operações em ambientes críticos de missão.


✅ CLT - 11h às 20h

✅ Atuação 100% remota

✅ Projeto com duração inicial de 1 ano, com possibilidade de extensão

✅ Inglês avançado/fluente mandatório


Requisitos

  • Sólida experiência com arquitetura e operações em ambientes AWS
  • Administração avançada de Linux (RHEL, Oracle Linux e Ubuntu)
  • Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform e/ou CloudFormation)
  • Automação com Shell Script e Python
  • Docker e Kubernetes (EKS é diferencial)
  • CI/CD e práticas DevOps
  • AWS IAM, segurança, governança e observabilidade
  • Experiência em troubleshooting, otimização de performance e suporte a ambientes críticos de produção.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com ambientes SAP hospedados na AWS
  • SAP S/4HANA e SAP HANA
  • AWS Launch Wizard para SAP
  • Arquiteturas de Alta Disponibilidade (HA) e Disaster Recovery (DR).

Se você gosta de desafios envolvendo Cloud Infrastructure, Linux, Automação e DevOps em escala corporativa , essa pode ser uma excelente oportunidade para dar o próximo passo na sua carreira.

title: Business Development & Marketing
description:
About iQIYI

iQIYI International is a global digital entertainment platform focused on Asian dramas, films, animation, variety shows and other content for international audiences. In Brazil and Latin America, we are building partnerships with leading media, telecom, digital platforms and brands to make Asian entertainment more accessible to local audiences.


Role purpose

Support iQIYI’s expansion in Brazil and Latin America by prospecting, developing and coordinating commercial and marketing partnerships. The role requires the ability to independently organize priorities, lead meetings, prepare proposals, follow up on opportunities and coordinate projects with external partners and internal teams in Brazil, Canada and Asia, without constant supervision.


Key responsibilities

1. Business Development & Partnerships – approximately 70%

  • Map, prospect and develop relationships with private and public free-to-air broadcasters, telecommunications operators, digital and OTT platforms, distributors, technology companies, payment providers, retailers, consumer brands and other strategic partners.
  • Build and maintain an organized pipeline of potential partners in Brazil and other Latin American markets, documenting contacts, opportunity stages, next steps, risks and timelines.
  • Prepare presentations, commercial proposals, preliminary partnership models, meeting minutes, progress reports and decision-support materials.
  • Lead initial meetings, identify partner needs and develop value propositions suited to different cooperation models.
  • Support negotiations involving content distribution, licensing, revenue sharing, subscription bundles, media/barter, co-marketing, customer benefits, promotions and other commercial models.
  • Negotiate commercial terms within approved parameters and coordinate validation with the Country Manager and relevant iQIYI functions; final approvals and signatures remain with management and headquarters.
  • Coordinate the progress of opportunities with internal content, marketing, product, technology, legal, finance, operations and other teams in Brazil, Canada and Asia.
  • Support partnership implementation after approval, ensuring alignment on scope, deliverables, timelines and performance indicators.
  • Conduct research on markets, competitors, potential partners and trends across streaming, television, telecommunications and entertainment in Latin America.
  • Represent iQIYI in partner meetings, industry events and business visits, with availability for occasional travel within Brazil and Latin America.

2. Marketing Partnerships – approximately 30%

  • Identify and structure marketing opportunities with commercial partners to promote the iQIYI brand, priority content launches and subscription offers.
  • Plan and coordinate co-marketing initiatives, partner campaigns, events, activations, content promotion and online/offline promotional projects.
  • Adapt global briefs and materials to the needs of Brazil and other Latin American markets, ensuring local relevance and compliance with brand guidelines.
  • Coordinate deliverables with internal and external stakeholders, including partners, agencies, public relations teams, influencers and vendors when applicable.
  • Track execution and results, gather evidence of delivery and prepare reports with learnings and recommendations.



Required qualifications

  • At least 3 years of experience in business development, partnerships, commercial roles, partnership marketing or related functions.
  • Hands-on experience in B2B prospecting, relationship management, proposal preparation and follow-up of negotiations or partner projects.
  • Fluent or native Portuguese.
  • Professional English, with the ability to participate in meetings, prepare presentations and communicate with international teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to work autonomously, set priorities, meet deadlines and keep stakeholders informed.
  • Strong verbal and written communication, negotiation, organization and relationship-building skills.
  • Availability to collaborate across time zones and travel occasionally within Brazil and Latin America.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, International Relations, Economics or a related field.
